title: The homology mate acts through the constructed open cohomology map
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ and $g:S′\to S$ be morphisms of schemes with $g$ and the second pullback projection $g′$ flat. Let $F$ be a module sheaf on $X$, $I$ an injective resolution of $F$, $J$ an injective resolution of $(g′)^*F$, and $t:I\to g′_*J$ any complex map. For each $p\ge0$, open $V\subset S$, choices $D:FlatBaseChangeOpenChoices(f,g,F,I,J,V)$ and class $\xi\in H^p(f^{-1}V,F)$, the section map of the adjoint of flatBaseChangeResolutionBeta sends D.sourceClass(p,xi) to D.targetClass(p,flatBaseChangeResolutionOpenMap(f,g,I,J,t,p,V,D)(xi)). No augmentation hypothesis on t is needed. The constructions are [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-resolution-construction], [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices], and [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-resolution-open-map].

proof.text: Flatness makes tensor pullback exact by [lem-weil-pbc-flat-module-pullback-exact-pushforward-injective]. Thus kernels, images and homology of K commute with tensor pullback. The inverse comparison in b is this exact homology comparison.

For a cycle s in K(V), the adjunction identity says that the unit followed by g_*c sends s to q(s), degreewise. Passing through the preserved kernel and homology quotient therefore sends its cycle class to the class of q(s). This uses only the defining adjunction identity and the universal properties of kernel and quotient.

The map theta is the sheafification of cycle classes with its canonical homology comparison [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices]. Naturality of sheafification and the evaluation comparison takes the preceding equality on cycle representatives to the displayed equality. Every element of section-complex homology is represented by a cycle, so this establishes equality of the additive group morphisms.

In the constructed open map [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-resolution-open-map], cancel the inverse target section/resolution comparison against the one in targetClass. In sourceClass and beta cancel the inverse source derived-image comparison using naturality of the tensor adjunction. The remaining equality is the cycle-class identity established in the preceding steps. This argument uses no augmentation and no moduleCohomologyFMap.

lean.statement:
theorem flatBaseChangeResolutionBeta_openMap_sections {X S S' : Scheme.{uBC}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S)
    [Flat g] [Flat (pullback.snd g f)] {F : X.Modules}
    (I : InjectiveResolution F)
    (J : InjectiveResolution ((tensorPullback (pullback.snd g f)).obj F))
    (t : I.cocomplex ⟶ ((pushforward (pullback.snd g f)).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj J.cocomplex)
    (p : ℕ) :
    ∀ (V : S.Opens)
        (D : FlatBaseChangeOpenChoices f g F I J V)
        (xi : (forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat.{uBC}).obj
          ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme.toRingedSpace p).obj
            ((restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).obj F))),
        Hom.app ((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction g)).homEquiv _ _
          (flatBaseChangeResolutionBeta f g I J t p)) V
          (D.sourceClass p xi) =
        D.targetClass p
          (flatBaseChangeResolutionOpenMap f g I J t p V D xi)
